svg.title: The four steps on a USB-C laptop plug
svg.desc: Five stages of the two-sided puller, left to right, the top row first, the plug end at the top; arrows numbered 1 to 4 show the steps, and red dashes mark the edges each step moved. Start, the defaults: the tool as the file opens, with a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Step 1 - Your Plug: plug length 23 mm, plug width at both ends 13 mm, cord thickness 7 mm, plug sides Rounded sides; red on the arms, the finger lobes and the zip stations. Step 2 - Size: hand size Large; red on the arms, the finger lobes and the zip stations. Step 3 - Attachment: attachment Zip ties; no strap slot on a plug this short, so nothing moved. Step 4 - Print Layout: both plates side by side in one file, what you print; nothing marked.
